column1: # Rulings on this pair, kept by hand. refuse with both sides: that shape is never a link, whatever proposes it (source: only from that source). refuse with one side and a source: those words leave that source's rows. accept: the shape is pinned and wins every competition.

column6: «cuando» opens the verse and renders וּבְלֶכֶת, when they went, not the second הַחַיּוֹת, the living creatures, which «animales» renders (EZK 1:19)

«Arabia» renders עֲרָב, Arabia, the fifth word; the second עֶרֶב, the mixed peoples, is «pueblos mezclados». Clear Bible crossed the two, and its record of עֶרֶב on the «de» before «Arabia» would otherwise be moved onto the name (JER 25:24)
